title: Pour Plating Protocol for Emiliania Huxleyi (Single Colonies)
author: Inbal Nussbaum
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p4ydqxw
materials: Autoclave 75 mL DDW with 0.75 g agarose
Let solidify to a loose consistency

steps.title: Prepare FSW Medium
steps.instruction: Heat 225 mL of filtered seawater (FSW) in a 50 °C water bath to prepare for 300 mL total volume (7 plates).

steps.title: Prepare Agar Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine cooled autoclaved agar (50 °C) with the heated FSW.

steps.title: Aliquot Agar Mixture
steps.instruction: Pour 40 mL of the FSW-agar mixture into a 50 mL conical tube for each sample.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Suspensions
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.5 mL of cells for each sample at the desired cell concentration.

steps.title: Temper Agar Mixture
steps.instruction: Remove the FSW-agar mix from the 32 °C bath and allow it to cool by 1-2 degrees.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the mixture does not drop to 27-28 °C, as it will start to solidify.

steps.title: Inoculate and Plate
steps.instruction: Combine the cell suspension with the agar mixture and plate.

substeps.instruction: Add the cell suspension to each tube.

steps.title: Incubate Plates
steps.instruction: Transfer plates to the growth room.

substeps.instruction: Monitor for single colonies, which should appear within 10 days without selection.
